query:
SELECT nd.id, nd.label, nd.mobileconfig, nd.last_updated, nd.last_seen, nd.hostname, nd.realm_id, jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('network_id', nc.network_id, 'mac', ndc.mac, 'ipv4_addr', nia.ipv4_addr) || row_to_json(nc)::jsonb - 'password' || jsonb_build_object('network', row_to_json(nn)) ORDER BY ndc.cred_id) AS "creds!: DeviceCredEmbedsFull",
            ARRAY_AGG(nc.password ORDER BY ndc.cred_id) as "cred_passwords!: Vec<Option<Encrypted<String>>>",
            jsonb_build_object('id', nd.account_id, 'full_name', coalesce(ap.full_name, ag.label), 'type', (CASE WHEN ap.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'person' ELSE 'group' END)) AS "account!: AccountEmbed"
            FROM net_devices nd
            JOIN net_device_creds ndc ON nd.id = ndc.device_id
            JOIN net_cred nc ON nc.id = ndc.cred_id
            JOIN net_networks nn ON nc.network_id = nn.id
            LEFT JOIN net_ip_assignments nia ON nia.device_id = ndc.device_id AND nia.cred_id = ndc.cred_id
            JOIN accounts_people ap ON nc.account_id = ap.id LEFT JOIN account_groups ag ON nc.account_id = ag.id WHERE nd.account_id = $1 AND
             nd.id = $2 GROUP BY nd.id, ap.id, ag.id
